accepted_increments.summary: Initialized repo-local Codex harness state, environment actions, reusable workflow skill copies, Python 3.11 venv setup, and tinygrad 0.12 device-context compatibility for tinygrad-gemma.
Made decode fallback explicit when tinygrad rejects symbolic Metal cache-store JIT graphs, extended the Metal smoke gate through generation, and recorded fallback status in benchmark rows.
Restored legal Metal TinyJit replay by replacing raw symbolic UOp cache stores with tinygrad's public slice assign/realize cache-write idiom, then pinned no-fallback decode in the Metal smoke gate.

Avoided physical K/V head repetition in the measured text decode path by reshaping grouped-query attention, improving the E2B int8 METAL 200-token warmup-excluded row from 8.918411 tok/s to 10.659780 tok/s.
Refreshed the real E2B int8 METAL 1000-token beam=0 floor on the grouped-query path, producing a no-fallback row with rollout_jit_count=999 and 6.245549 warmup-excluded tok/s.

Ported the Metal-only sliding-window decode JIT switch into the conditional generation path used by E2B int8, improving the 1000-token warmup-excluded row from 6.245549 tok/s to 8.300076 tok/s with decode_fallback=false.

Profiled the post-window decode TinyJit, then fused inference-only MLP gate/up projections, improving the E2B int8 METAL 1000-token warmup-excluded row from 8.300076 tok/s to 9.303522 tok/s with decode_fallback=false.

next_target_plan: Current proof: E2B int8 METAL beam=0 max_new_tokens=1000 decode_warmup_tokens=20 took 136.105067 s total and measured 9.303522 tok/s over 980 tokens with rollout_jit_count=999 and decode_fallback=false. The post-window 700/520 row measured 11.891932 tok/s. The fused post-window JIT profile at context length 700 measured 110.302 ms synthetic decode: MLP 38.938 ms, attention 26.236 ms, norm 13.447 ms, logits/argmax 1.793 ms. The local int8 checkpoint manifest has 0 quantized tensors and raw bfloat16 weights, so real speedup likely requires reducing MLP/norm/attention kernel volume or implementing runtime int8 matmul rather than optimizing logits.
